instruction: Duplicate the first slide and place the copy at the very end of the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.expected_last_text_contains: Adapted from the Purdue Online Writing Lab

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully duplicated the last two slides and inserted copies in alternating order in LibreOffice Impress, going from 24 to 26 slides. Completed in 38 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate slide panel, select slides, duplicate slides, move/reorder slides, save presentation in LibreOffice Impress
metadata.task_rationale: Tests slide duplication to a different position. The original task duplicated last 2 slides; this variation duplicates the first slide to the end, testing a reversed direction of the same capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires duplicating slide 1 (title slide) and placing copy at the end. Evaluator checks: (1) total count is 25 (0.5 pts), (2) last slide contains 'Adapted from the Purdue Online Writing Lab' matching slide 1 content (0.5 pts).

scoring_breakdown.last_slide_content: 0.5 - Last slide matches original slide 1 content

Metric correctly handles expected parameter as direct rules dict (expected.get('expected_count')) — proper for type='rule'.
